background_initial:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Tekken 3 PlayStation 1 stage BACKGROUND texture, one extremely wide 4:1 panoramic strip, ideally 2048x512.
Create a new PS1-era adaptation of Jun Kazama's Heavenly Garden stage from Tekken Tag Tournament 2.
Input image 1 is the actual Heavenly Garden reference: use its scene identity, not its HD fidelity. Input image 2 is the extracted original Tekken 3 forest panorama: match its low-resolution prerendered bitmap texture fidelity and panoramic layout, NOT its forest subject or dark colors.
Scene: luminous but restrained lavender and dusty pink sky, cream-colored chunky clouds, two faint pastel rainbow arcs, clear pale jade-lilac water; one prominent crooked cherry blossom tree on a small floating rocky island around the left third, a few distant mossy floating stones, scattered low polygon-looking lily pads and pale pink, blue, peach lotus flowers along the far waterline.
Composition: cylindrical 360-degree game background strip, very wide 4:1, fills entire canvas with no borders. Continuous even horizon around 70% down; water below horizon, sky above. Complete tree visible. No foreground fighting platform: foreground floor is a separate texture. Left and right edges must meet naturally at identical sky/water heights with quiet clouds and water near the seam, no cut-off objects at either edge. Do not mirror the scene. Distribute landmarks across full width, not a single centered postcard.
Style: authentic 1997-1998 PlayStation prerendered scenery, visibly limited-palette and grainy fine pixel dithering, blocky small texture detail, coarse branching/tree canopy clusters, slightly muddy low-resolution edges like stock Tekken 3. Do NOT make polished modern pixel art or high-definition concept art. No smooth photoreal reflections, bloom, HDR, lens effects, depth of field or rich ultra-fine foliage. No fighters, HUD, logos, text, borders, labels, watermarks, black letterboxing. Water and terrain matte and low-detail.
Return only the finished panoramic background texture.
background_final:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the attached Heavenly Garden panorama.
Keep this scene's colors, cherry tree on floating island, clouds, pastel rainbow and lotus water. Change only the COMPOSITION to an extremely wide, shallow 4:1 usable game texture strip, and lower visual fidelity to authentic grainy 1998 PlayStation scenery. The current 2.5:1 image is too tall.
Important output layout: place the COMPLETE panorama inside a centered horizontal band FOUR TIMES AS WIDE AS IT IS TALL. If the output canvas cannot be 4:1, use pure solid black padding above and below that band. Example on a 2048x1024 canvas: artwork occupies y=256..767 only, black above and below. No text or labels in the padding. Do NOT stretch or squash the tree; recompose and extend the environment horizontally. Preserve the whole tree and rainbow inside the 4:1 strip.
Within the actual artwork band: horizon at 78% of band height, only a thin distant water strip below. Remove most foreground water. Keep distant lotus flowers low along the horizon. Quiet lavender sky/water at both far ends, with matching edge colors for horizontal wrapping. Keep all landmarks away from far edges. Coarse low-resolution texture detail, limited colors, 1990s prerendered bitmap, not glossy HD artwork. No UI, no fighters, no labels, no watermarks, no newly invented buildings.
floor:
Use case: stylized-concept
Create ONLY a square seamless tileable floor diffuse/albedo texture for a 1998 PlayStation Tekken 3 adaptation of Jun's Heavenly Garden. Use the attached actual Tag Tournament 2 screenshot only as color/material reference; no sky or objects copied. The second reference is an original 64x64 Tekken 3 floor tile: match that small-texture fidelity.
Orthographic TOP DOWN straight at the ground, absolutely no horizon, no perspective, no lighting gradient or vignette. Clear extremely shallow pale gray-jade water with muted lilac and dusty pink sky reflections, irregular understated short ripple clusters, a few tiny pale pink cherry blossom petals; no lotus flowers, no lily pads, no floating islands, no recognizable tree/cloud/rainbow reflection. Those large landmarks belong to the backdrop and would repeat too obviously on a tiled fighting floor.
Deliberately very low resolution: appearance of a 64 by 64 TEXEL texture enlarged using nearest neighbor, visible square pixel clusters, only 16 flat muted colors, coarse PS1-era palette dithering, no photoreal detail. Periodic material continues perfectly across both pairs of opposite edges for seamless XY tiling; consistent brightness at all edges. Texture fills the entire square, no frame, no black borders, no grid, no text, no fighters, no UI, no watermark. Favor quiet softly mottled water with subtle pale ripples over busy sparkle noise. Return one square texture only.
